#oms 1.18

##1


$X\sim\Gamma(\lambda,r) \newline f_X(x)=\lambda^r*\Gamma(r)^{-1}*x^{r-1}*exp(-\lambda*x)$

$\Rightarrow L(\lambda,r)=\prod_{i=1}^nf_X(\lambda,r,x_i)=\lambda^{r*n}*\Gamma(r)^{-n}*\prod_{i=1}^nx_i^{r-1}*exp(-\lambda\sum_{i=1}^nx_i)$

##2


$l(\lambda,r)=r*n*log(\lambda)-n*\log(\Gamma(r))+(r-1)\sum_{i=1}^nlog(x_i)-\lambda*\sum_{i=1}^nx_i$
$\dfrac{\partial l}{\partial \lambda}=\dfrac{r*n}{\lambda}-\sum_{i=1}^nx_i=0\newline\dfrac{\partial l}{\partial r}=n*\log(\lambda)-n*\dfrac{d}{dr}log(\Gamma(r))+\sum_{i=1}^nlog(x_i)=0$


##3

```{r}
set.seed(1)
x <- rgamma(1000,shape = 2, rate = 3)

An<-mean(x)
Bn<-mean(log(x))
f<-function(x){
  return (digamma(x)-log(x)-Bn+log(An))
}

r_hat<-uniroot(f,c(1,100))$root

lambda_hat<-r_hat/An
print("r estimat")
r_hat
print("lambda estimat")
lambda_hat
```
